lead: A meter shows an amount within a known range (disk usage, a rating). Unlike Progress, it doesn't say how far a task has got. `role="meter"` comes from Base UI; the look fully reuses Progress's theme style.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Meter has no CSS file of its own: its whole look comes from `progress.css`. To change colour at a threshold, the caller switches `color` by value.
styling.meter: Written on `progress`, for theme styles that want to tell a meter apart
